# Lot: purge our examples, templates, showcases and generators; replace them with real Google code, forked and generated by CI

Order of the owner, 2026-11-21: replace every example, template, showcase and generator with real ports in Kotlin, Flutter, Angular, JS and Rust of Google's work (Google, Android, Drive, Search, YouTube, Chromium 160, Googlebook, AI Studio, Gemini on Android and web, Antigravity…). Replace templates, showcases, components, styles and tokens with the real ones, forked as submodules and generated through CI, actions, workflows and scripts.

## What can and cannot be forked (checked live with gh api on 2026-11-21)

**Open source, forkable as submodules (repo, last push, licence):**

| Repo | Last push | Licence | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| android/nowinandroid | 2026-11-21 | Apache-2.0 | the reference Compose/M3 app (core/designsystem) |
| android/compose-samples | 2026-11-19 | Apache-2.0 | |
| android/snippets | 2026-11-21 | Apache-2.0 | |
| android/architecture-samples | 2026-11-21 | Apache-2.0 | |
| material-components/material-components-android | 2026-11-18 | Apache-2.0 | |
| material-components/material-web | 2026-11-20 | Apache-2.0 | M3 web components and CSS token names |
| material-foundation/material-color-utilities | 2026-11-20 | Apache-2.0 | |
| google/material-design-icons | 2026-10-23 | Apache-2.0 | already the source of material.aphrody.com |
| googlefonts/googlesans-code | 2026-11-04 | OFL-1.1 | |
| flutter/flutter | 2026-11-21 | BSD-3-Clause | |
| flutter/samples | 2026-11-17 | licence NOASSERTION | read its LICENSE file before forking |
| angular/components | 2026-11-20 | MIT | Angular Material |
| chromium/chromium | 2026-11-21 | BSD-3-Clause | the milestone 160 branch via depot_tools/`fw depot`; never a full submodule of the whole tree in a normal clone |
| google-gemini/cookbook | 2026-11-21 | Apache-2.0 | |

**Closed source, cannot be forked:** Googlebook, AI Studio, the Gemini apps (Android, web), Drive, Search, YouTube and Antigravity. For those, the only real material is:
- their public pages, measured and never copied (as done for googlebook in `google-design.md`);
- their public APIs and SDKs (Gemini API, Drive API, YouTube Data API), used through official SDK repos where they are open.

Rebuilding their UI from screenshots would be a copy of their design, not a port. Our surfaces follow M3 and the measured patterns instead.

## Work

1. **Inventory** every example, template, showcase, demo and generator in fw main:
   - `git grep -l` over `examples/`, `templates/`, `showcase`, `demo`, the generators in `tools/` and `aphrody/tooling/`, the NSH examples and the `aphrody/examples/nsh` TSX;
   - the stitch and design generators, and the synthetic media fixtures.

   Delete each one, or replace it with the real upstream equivalent.
2. **Fork** the repos above into aphrody-labs (forks-follow.yml keeps them current). Add them as submodules with relative URLs, shallow and `update = none`, under the paths `layout.toml` gives. Pin each to a release.
3. **Generate through CI** every component, style and token we use from those forks:
   - M3 tokens through `fw m3 sync` (lot `m3-is-the-brand.md`);
   - icons from material-design-icons (already live);
   - web components from material-web;
   - Compose from MaterialTheme and the NiA designsystem patterns.

   A workflow regenerates on upstream change, and a `--check` mode fails on drift.
4. **Ports:** a port into Rust/GPUI or wasm is real only when it is generated from, or tested against, the upstream source. For example, M3 components rendered in GPUI and compared screenshot to screenshot with material-web or Compose renders of the same component.
5. **Guard:** a CI check fails on new example, template or showcase directories outside the generated or submodule paths.
